newsitem.title: USA: Reebok to put "child labor" label on balls.
newsitem.headline: Reebok to put "child labor" label on balls.

text.p: Reebok International Ltd said Tuesday it would affix a label to its soccer balls assuring customers they are manufactured without child labor.
This spring, the company will begin placing labels on its soccer balls that read: "Guarantee: Manufactured without child labor."

"Reebok is taking this step in response to a specific child labor situation that exists in Pakistan, where most of the world's quality soccer balls are produced," said Peter Moore, senior vice president of Reebok's global soccer ball division.
Reebok has charged that about 20 percent of the soccer balls manufactured in Pakistan are hand-stitched by children.

The athletic shoe and sports equipment company has nearly completed building its own soccer ball factory in Pakistan, which will guarantee no children are involved in the manufacturing, the company says.
